function.description: Mint a Pendle PT and YT together from one payment token — splits the token into an EQUAL amount of principal token (PT, fixed yield to expiry) and yield token (YT, variable yield that decays to zero at expiry) in a single transaction. Approval-gated; pins the canonical Pendle Router. REQUIRES a fresh matching pendle.py.quote (direction mint) first.
function.name: pendle__py_mint

amountIn.description: Amount of the payment token in human-readable units.

chain.description: Chain slug or id — one of Pendle's 11 chains (e.g. 'ethereum', 'arbitrum', 'base', 'bsc').

pt.description: The market's PT (principal token) CONTRACT ADDRESS — the anchor that resolves the market and its YT.

tokenIn.description: The payment token CONTRACT ADDRESS to spend (ERC-20; use WETH for ETH).
